context: Desk request: reading a letter (changes after Hollis's death).

lines.speaker: char.walter_hollis
lines.text: Shipmate! Letter from my old bosun. Eyes are bad. Read it to me?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Come down to the desk, Mr. Hollis. I'll read it slow.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: A letter came for Walter. From his ship. Will you read it to me, Mr. Arce?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Sit, Mrs. Pruitt. 'Dear Walt. The reunion's in October…'
